query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Deploy Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow one concurrent deployment
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        
      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v1
        with:
          dotnet-version: 6.x
      
      - name: Setup DocFX
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-chocolatey@v1
        with:
          args: install docfx
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: src
        run: dotnet restore
      
      - name: DocFX Build
        working-directory: docs
        run: docfx docfx.json
        continue-on-error: false
      
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v1
        with:
          path: 'docs/_site/'
  deploy:
    needs: build
    
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v2
      
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v1

Bound jobs with a custom timeout

Pattern: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (job_timeout)

When is bound jobs with a custom timeout applicable?

Assess bound jobs with a custom timeout for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Representative successful-duration history exists

Contraindications: Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit

Method: Choose an explicit budget with operational headroom; Measure false timeout failures separately

Reported finding: Custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 12.9, "paid": 8.1}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.6; Table 4; PDF pp. 7, 8: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Pattern: P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE (failing_schedule_suppression)

When is pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows applicable?

Assess pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: A monitored pause/resume policy is approved

Contraindications: Continuous monitoring or periodic checks are mandatory

Derive timeout candidates from successful history

Pattern: P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT (history_based_timeout)

When is derive timeout candidates from successful history applicable?

Assess derive timeout candidates from successful history for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Successful job history is representative

Contraindications: New workloads or runners invalidate historical bounds

Method: Use past data only when proposing a limit; Evaluate the candidate on future slow and cold runs

Reported finding: History-based timeout savings are retrospective estimates.

Reported metrics: {"buffer_multiplier": 1.1, "historical_cap_hours": 6, "paid_total_vm_time_reduction_percent": 3.5}
